_: Lift rank system v6. Every exercise has its own male/female 46-rank threshold ladder. Scores use allometric bodyweight scaling, age, height/ROM, equipment/load mode, warm-up exclusion and exercise-specific standards. Muscle ranks aggregate exercise percentiles independently.
_legRankNote: Retained for compatibility; ranking uses exercise-specific standards.

sources: Strength Level 2026 exercise-specific standards and percentile framework (5/20/50/80/95 percentiles) used as calibration anchors.
ExRx-style strength-standard methodology used for movement/type calibration where direct exercise data is limited.
Obscure variations use editable exercise-specific ladders derived from their explicit movement metadata; they are not treated as a universal bodyweight multiplier.
ranking.topTierNote: Blue Gem is calibrated above the Strength Level-style Elite (~95th percentile) anchor to target roughly the top 1% while preserving the existing rank name.
ranking.romCorrection: height exponent by exercise ROM class; capped at ±10%
ranking.ageCorrection: smooth age curve; 25-40 baseline; youth and older-lifter bonus capped at 20%
ranking.machineLeniency: encoded in each exercise threshold ladder; no universal machine multiplier
ranking.unilateralRule: unilateral loads are scored per side; bilateral dumbbell loads use both dumbbells

muscleModel.note: Each muscle is scored only from its mapped exercises; transfer weights remain exercise-specific in app.js.
